label: Peplink Balance One
description: Small-business load-balancing router: 2x GE WAN and 8x GE LAN out of the box, 600 Mbps routing throughput, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet, which states **two numbers per row because a licence changes the answer**: Ethernet WAN port **2 / 5 (GE)** and LAN port **8 / 5 (GE)**, with Router Throughput **600Mbps / 400Mbps**. The second figure applies once the WAN Activation License is fitted, which converts three LAN ports into WAN ports. The base configuration (2 WAN, 8 LAN, 600 Mbps) is what is modelled here; if you have the five-WAN licence the port split and the throughput ceiling both change, and the file's interface list will be wrong for your unit.
